sentences.span: The 10-year yield broke 4.40% on Friday for the first time since May.
sentences.why: Exact match on value, date, and framing.

sentences.span: We think the move is a bear-steepener: the front end is anchored by a Fed on hold
sentences.why: Document is J.P. Morgan Rates Strategy; 'We think' is JPMorgan's own view, correctly attributed as 'JPMorgan reads'.

sentences.span: We recommend paying 5s30s at 62bp with a stop at 48bp.
sentences.why: The trade call belongs to JPMorgan ('We recommend', the authoring desk of this note), not Citi. Citi is mentioned separately in the source only as holding a different, non-trade view ('sees the break as a positioning flush and expects 4.40% to hold'). The sentence reassigns JPMorgan's call to Citi, changing who said it.

No mention of Goldman, a 4.75% target, year-end, or foreign demand anywhere in the source text. The only forward-looking framing in the source is JPMorgan's own steepener thesis tied to the PCE print, not a yield-level forecast from Goldman.

sentences.span: A hot core PCE print on Thursday (consensus 0.3% m/m) would validate our steepener; a soft print would not by itself reverse it
sentences.why: Matches Thursday core PCE, 0.3% m/m consensus, and the print's role as the decisive test for the steepener trade.
